head: M&S delivery pass: annual next-day delivery subscription coming in 2027
dek: Marks & Spencer plans an annual delivery pass that gives subscribers next-day delivery, launching next year. It announced the plan at its Capital Markets Day, together with a pay-later option called M&S Pay.
details: M&S says it will scale the delivery pass over the two to three years after launch. No price has been given yet. M&S Pay will let shoppers pay online in three interest-free monthly payments or spread the cost over a longer period with flexible credit. M&S also plans to offer Sephora in 50 stores and online.
means: If you order from M&S often, a yearly fee may soon cover next-day delivery, but the price isn't known yet.
todo: Nothing to do yet. Wait for the price before deciding whether a yearly pass would save you money.
